definition: Formal giving up of a position of power or authority.
author: Horace Walpole
quote: In the morning Manfred signed his abdication of the principality, with the approbation of Hippolita, and each took on them the habit of religion in the neighbouring convents.
example_sentence: Skipping the meeting was an abdication of his duty as captain.
